1. ▲ Fix now · Your server configuration needs review before you connect.
   toy-shell-exporter / client not asserted (workstation) | explicit file; parsed as Claude-style config
   Source: examples/sandbox/fixtures/synthetic-mcp-config.json
   What we saw: 'toy-shell-exporter' launches through shell wrapper 'bash'; review args before connecting.
details: ['Shell wrappers can hide compound commands in arguments.']
   Why it matters: Your client uses the configured entry. The reported concern can change its reach or reduce audit
coverage. Connecting before review may run unintended code or leave part of the config unchecked.
   How to fix (About 5 minutes for an initial review): Follow the finding's manual remediation at the named config
entry. If intent is unclear, remove that entry temporarily, restart the client, and review the command and source before
restoring it.
   Manual step: Inspect this entry's shell arguments. If a direct executable and argument list can express the intended
launch, use those instead of a shell wrapper. Otherwise remove this entry temporarily and restart the client while you
review the script.
   How sure: A static config check; it does not establish malicious code or an observed incident.
   see: https://github.com/saagpatel/MCPAudit/blob/main/docs/findings/index.md#configuration-health
   Recheck:
     mcp-audit check --config \
     examples/sandbox/fixtures/synthetic-mcp-config.json
   +3 related findings in --details (included in totals).
